#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int len = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(len - 1)));
    
    vector<double> ar(n, 0.0), ai(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        ai[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(ar, ai, false);
    
    vector<double> br(n, 0.0), bi(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        br[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bi[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(br, bi, false);
    
    vector<double> resr(n, 0.0), resi(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> resj(n, 0.0), resk(n, 0.0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        
        double a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;
        
        double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;
        
        resr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resi[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        resj[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        resk[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    
    fft(resr, resi, true);
    fft(resj, resk, true);
    
    vector<int> output(len);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        long long x = llround(resr[i]);
        long long y = llround(resj[i]);
        long long z = llround(resi[i]);
        output[i] = (int)((x + ((y % mod) << 15) + ((z % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return output;
}

void fft(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        for (; j ^ bit >= bit; bit >>= 1) {
            j ^= bit;
        }
        if (i < j) {
            swap(re[i], re[j]);
            swap(im[i], im[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        double wlen_re = cos(angle);
        double wlen_im = sin(angle);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            double w_re = 1.0;
            double w_im = 0.0;
            int half = len >> 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double ur = re[i + j];
                double ui = im[i + j];
                double vr = re[i + j + half] * w_re - im[i + j + half] * w_im;
                double vi = re[i + j + half] * w_im + im[i + j + half] * w_re;
                
                re[i + j] = ur + vr;
                im[i + j] = ui + vi;
                re[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                im[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
                
                double tmp = w_re * wlen_re - w_im * wlen_im;
                w_im = w_re * wlen_im + w_im * wlen_re;
                w_re = tmp;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

class FastInput {
private:
    istream& is;
    vector<char> buffer;
    int len, ptr;
    
public:
    FastInput(istream& is) : is(is), buffer(1024) {
        len = 0;
        ptr = 0;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (c <= 32) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Invalid character");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        }
        return res * sign;
    }
    
private:
    int read() {
        if (ptr >= len) {
            is.read(buffer.data(), buffer.size());
            len = is.gcount();
            ptr = 0;
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return (unsigned char)buffer[ptr++];
    }
};

int main() {
    FastInput in(cin);
    int MOD = 998244353;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    
    vector<int> poly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx = in.nextInt();
        if (idx < 10) poly[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> result = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = multiply(result, poly, MOD);
        }
        poly = multiply(poly, poly, MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int val : result) {
        answer = (answer + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
